title: Bind VLAN To Backhaul Request
description: Mirrors telux::data::net::VlanBindConfig (vlanId + BackhaulInfo). slot/profileId are only meaningful for WWAN backhauls -- the SDK documents them as don't-care otherwise, so they are optional here. The deprecated bindWithProfile() path maps onto this with backhaul pinned to WWAN.

bhVlanId.description: Set only when the backhaul is itself a VLAN (e.g. VLAN-over-ETH); mirrors BackhaulInfo::vlanId.
